HO00003379.title: Practical Magic 2

HO00003425.title: Bad Apples
HO00003425.description: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student

HO00003371.title: Don't Look Back In Anger

"It’s a story in which hatred—the knife as a metaphor of hate—is answered and finally overcome by love.” Salman Rushdie

Followed by a recorded Q&A with director Alex Gibney, Salman Rushdie and Rachel Eliza Griffiths.
